records.reason: Grants the unholy sanctification trait and knowledge of two rituals (Call Spirit, Commune). No field grants a FIXED sanctification (only `choice` flags where the player picks holy/unholy) and nothing grants known rituals — innateSpells would wrongly make them per-day innate casts. The secondary-caster substitution is table-resolved.
A 1-action rage effect that changes YOUR fists for a round (ghost touch + Strength checks vs incorporeal). Nothing records it; the mode lane is the vehicle for a timed self-state.

mode.name: Ghost Wrangler
mode.duration: until the start of your next turn
mode.note: Your fists gain the effects of the ghost touch property rune, and you can make Strength-based skill checks against incorporeal creatures.

records.reason: A 2-action attack: it imposes a 5th-rank Vision of Death on a target and frightens the target's allies. Everything lands on the enemy side; the DC is the character's existing class/spell DC.

"You gain the Advanced Undead Benefits" (Book of the Dead p.44) = darkvision, poison resistance equal to half your level, +2 vs disease/poison and +1 vs paralysis/sleep. None of it is recorded (Ghost Dedication already models Basic Undead Benefits with immunities + fly). Object interaction is a table-resolved check.
A 1-action deviant power that manipulates an object (or, with an awakening, attacks a target's Fortitude DC). It grants an action resolved at the table and changes no statistic of the character.
Legacy duplicate of ghostly-grasp with the same grant: Advanced Undead Benefits (darkvision, poison resistance half level, +2 vs disease/poison, +1 vs paralysis/sleep). Nothing carries it.
An action-economy trigger — Hunt Prey as a free action on initiative against a giant. No statistic changes; the GM adjudicates disguised giants.
Two crits on the same giant force it to save or die against the character's existing class DC. Entirely on the target's side.

Changes the footprint of snares prepared for quick deployment (2 quick-deployment snares buy one 10-by-10 snare). A deployment/crafting option resolved at the table; no character statistic and no new formula.

Grants 10-foot reach on all melee weapons and unarmed attacks until the rage ends. The unconditional `reach` field would over-grant (it applies only while raging) and `whileActive` carries no reach, so the toggleable-state lane is the fit.

mode.name: Giant's Lunge
mode.note: All your melee weapons and unarmed attacks have 10-foot reach. This doesn't increase the reach of an attack that already has the reach trait, but it does combine with size-based reach increases such as Giant's Stature.

records.reason: You become Large with +5 reach and clumsy 1 until you stop raging. sizeOverride/reach are unconditional fields and would over-grant outside rage; the mode lane is how the app carries a timed size/reach state.

mode.name: Giant's Stature
mode.note: You are Large: your reach increases by 5 feet and you are clumsy 1 until you stop raging. Your equipment grows with you. Requires that you were Medium or smaller.

records.reason: An exemplar ikon: the immanence regrows a limb or organ after 10 minutes (narrative healing) and the transcendence is a 1-action ability used at the table — and the printed transcendence text is truncated in the source record, so there is nothing to model from anyway.

A real extra spell slot at your HIGHEST rank, usable only for mystery-granted spells. spellSlotBonus can only say perRank (every rank — a huge over-grant) or byRank with a fixed rank number, and the highest rank moves with level; there is no 'highest rank only' form and no way to restrict the slot's contents.

The megafauna companion becomes Huge. The companion-mod registry exists but has no size field, so the size (and its space/reach/Bulk consequences) is recorded nowhere; a note-only mod is the precedent (stealthy-companion).

companionMod.note: Gigantic Megafauna Companion: your megafauna companion's size increases to Huge. Nothing else about its statistics changes — adjust its space, reach, and Bulk limit by hand.

records.reason: Adds a forced-movement save (against the existing class DC) to a successful unstable Megaton Strike. The whole effect is push distance applied to the target.
Changes the geometry of Megavolt's line (it bounces off barriers). Area shape resolved at the table; no character statistic.
Lets you Make an Impression immediately instead of after 1 minute, and retry after conversation. A social skill activity resolved at the table with no bonus or proficiency change.
A 1-action eidolon evolution that glides (5 feet down, 25 forward). Gliding is not a fly Speed, so there is no speed to grant — it is an action resolved at the table.
Doubles jaws damage against unattended, inanimate OBJECTS over 3 actions. Object destruction is GM-adjudicated and no creature-facing statistic changes.

Grants the critical specialization effect with five named weapons; the crit-spec lane (critSpec + critSpecWeapons.bases, read by derive.ts weaponMatches) carries exactly this and the record has neither. Ids verified in core.json (flail, khopesh, mambele, spear, war-flail); the sibling gnoll-weapon-expertise is already modelled in featGrantsAuto.

Learn three new languages. The sheet tracks languages (character.languages, its own rail card) but NO feat field grants them — the only addedLanguages field is on the per-character override record, not on feats, and even core Multilingual is unmodelled. The lane itself is missing.
Replaces Feint's success/critical-success effects with attack-roll penalties imposed on the TARGET. Nothing on the character's own sheet changes.

Grants the Goblin Jubilee fireworks display — a 3-action area attack that already exists as its own action record in the data and is resolved at the table. Like every other Firework Technician display feat, it changes no character statistic.
A reaction that lets you Step. An action resolved at the table.
A 3-action grapple finisher: hurl, jump, Strike, repeat. Damage and falling damage are resolved at the table against a grabbed creature; nothing persists on the sheet.

A 1-action fist Strike that either converts its damage to spirit or grants temporary HP equal to half your level for 1 round. An action resolved at the table; the sheet already has a temporary-HP field to enter the result.

Fast healing 20 and the deadly d12 trait on every unarmed Strike — both permanent, both absent. There is no fast-healing field and no lane that adds a trait to existing Strikes; the app's own convention (VitalsRail) is that a numberless persistent state like fast healing lives in a mode's note.

mode.name: Golden Body
mode.note: Fast healing 20: you regain 20 HP at the start of each of your turns as long as you have at least 1 HP. Your unarmed Strikes also gain the deadly d12 trait.

records.reason: A spellshape that retypes one spell's physical damage as cold iron/silver/steel (adamantine at 14th) for the purposes of the TARGET's weaknesses and resistances. Resolved when the spell is cast.
A 2-action activity: Stride twice, then a horns Strike that adds 1d6 persistent bleed if you moved 20 feet. An action resolved at the table; the horns Strike itself comes from the minotaur ancestry.
Extends your Aid reaction to an ALLY's Reflex save. It changes only an ally's statistic.

Lets you roll Acrobatics in place of Athletics for High Jump and Long Jump. A roll-time skill substitution — SKILL_ACTIONS is a static per-skill reference list with no per-character substitution, and no bonus or proficiency changes.

Fast healing 5 is a permanent statistic the sheet never shows (no fast-healing field anywhere in the engine). The mode note is the app's own convention for a numberless persistent state. The temporary-HP rider is target/ally-side and the limb regrowth is narrative.

mode.name: Grand Medic's Mask
mode.note: Fast healing 5. A lost limb or body part regrows within 1 day. Immediately after you Cast a non-cantrip Spell that targets only one creature, you can also give that creature temporary Hit Points equal to the spell's rank until the start of your next turn.

records.reason: Adds a daily temporary scroll with a 6th-rank spell (7th at 20th level) — a real per-day resource whose spell the player PICKS. Neither Scroll Esoterica nor Elaborate Scroll Esoterica carries any field, and there is no lane for daily temporary items: effectChoices+spellFilter only grants innate or focus spells, which would be an over-grant (unlimited-target casting rather than a one-use scroll).

Lets one treated item carry two active talismans instead of one. The app does not enforce the one-talisman suppression rule in the first place, so nothing on the sheet changes; it is an item-handling rule applied at the table.

A PICK the player never gets to make: choose Embrace Nothingness, Qi Form, or another 9th-rank qi spell, gained as a focus spell. The identical lower-level feat advanced-qi-spells is already modelled with exactly this shape, so the lane is proven.

effectChoices.prompt: Grandmaster Qi Spells: choose a 9th-rank qi spell (such as Embrace Nothingness or Qi Form)

records.reason: Makes a creature damaged by your horde's Mobbing Assault off-guard. A condition applied to the target, from a horde the app does not model as a companion.

A toggled grip (switched with an Interact action) that gives a qualifying two-handed weapon 10-foot reach at the cost of one damage die step. Both halves are real weapon statistics and neither is recorded; the toggle makes it a mode rather than the unconditional `reach` field.

mode.name: Extended Grasp
mode.note: While held in your extended grasp, a two-handed melee weapon that lacks reach and deals at least 1d6 damage gains 10-foot reach, and its damage die is reduced by one step.

records.reason: A spellshape: +30 feet of range on the next single-target spell plus a Fortitude save that pulls the TARGET toward you. Both apply at cast time on the enemy side.

"You gain the Advanced Undead Benefits" — darkvision, poison resistance equal to half your level, +2 vs disease/poison, +1 vs paralysis/sleep — none of it recorded (Mummy Dedication already models its fire weakness and immunities). The extra half-level resistance to bound-terrain damage has no lane (it keys off an environment, not a damage type) and is left out deliberately rather than faked as a damage type.

Upgrades your undead-sensing to an IMPRECISE sense with a 60-foot range; the sheet's senses list shows nothing. lifesense is the app's established selector for this kind of essence-sense (sense-ki, cultivators-keen-eye use it the same way); it is marginally broader than 'undead only', which is noted in the grant rather than left unrecorded.
A Strike that, on a hit, extends Reaper of Repose's benefits to all Strikes against that undead for 1 round. An action whose effect is tracked on the target.
Lets you use Spirit Lore or Haunt Lore for Make an Impression/Request against incorporeal creatures, explicitly at the GM's discretion. No bonus, no proficiency, no new skill.
Chains extra Cleave Strikes while you keep dropping foes to 0 HP. Pure action-sequence resolution at the table.

Adds eight property runes (Brilliant, Corrosive, Flaming, Frost, Holy, Shock, Thundering, Unholy) to the daily rune pick that Harbinger's Armament already implements as a `choice` with flag harbingerRune and five options. The player's daily menu stays at five. No field lets one feat EXPAND another record's choice options; adding a second choice here would grant a second rune, an over-grant.
Adds clumsy/stupefied to the conditions Cruelty can impose on its target. Target-side option list chosen at cast time.
Extends the list of conditions your bombs impose on the creatures they hit. Every added option lands on the target.
Makes your hunted prey off-guard for longer. A condition applied to the target.

Broadens what Sacrifice Armor can absorb and halves the damage of a crit/critical Reflex failure. It changes the outcome of a reaction resolved at the table against a known incoming damage total — the app does not resolve damage or degrees of success.
Adds blinded/deafened/sickened/slowed to what Merciful Elixir can counteract on the elixir's drinker. Resolved when the elixir is used.
Adds conditions to the Mercy list — a counteract applied to an ally (or yourself) at the table. No statistic on the sheet changes.
Gives the ALLY holding your companion shield your shield's AC bonus and lets you Shield Block for them. It changes only an ally's statistics; your own shield stats are unchanged.
Ignore greater difficult terrain from snow and ice. The app models no terrain, so there is nothing on the sheet to change (the base Snow Step feat is inert for the same reason).
Gives your SPELLS ghost touch and lets them reach projected/possessing/ethereal creatures. It changes what your spells can affect on the target side, resolved at the table.

While in oni form your reach increases by 5 feet and the form lasts 10 minutes without Sustaining. The stances lane carries oni-form's note but knows nothing of this upgrade, and the unconditional `reach` field would over-grant outside the form.

mode.name: Oni Form (Greater)
mode.note: Your Oni Form lasts 10 minutes with no need to Sustain it, and while in it your reach increases by 5 feet (on top of the form's usual Large size and clumsy 1).

records.reason: A constant Speak with Plants effect plus plants being friendly — a communication/social capability the GM adjudicates. It grants no spell slot, no innate casting cadence, and no statistic.
A free action at the start of your turn: a Recall Knowledge check that reveals a tracked creature's weakness and relays it to allies. Information gathering resolved at the table.

All three parts resolve at the table on the enemy side: your weapons count as cold iron against fey (a check against the TARGET's weakness), a critical failure on a save vs a fey spell becomes a failure (a degree adjustment — the app does not resolve rolls against a DC), and a critical hit imposes Faerie Fire on the fey.

A 2-action unarmed Strike with extra weapon damage dice that ignores resistance up to your level. An activity resolved at the table; the extra dice apply only to that Strike, not to the character's Strike statistics.

Upgrades a success on a save against fear to a critical success and makes the fear's source off-guard. A roll-time degree adjustment (the app rolls dice but never resolves a degree of success against a DC) plus a condition on the enemy.
A 1-action glide (5 or 10 feet down, up to 25 forward). Gliding is not a fly Speed, so there is no speed to grant — an action resolved at the table.
